notes: This contract pins Umbra's bounded IEEE 1516.1-2025 handle-normalization support-services slice to the official C++ RTIambassador declarations. The embedded development profile validates connection, joined membership, and each specific invalid-handle exception; it produces stable execution-scoped point-range coordinates for federate, object-class, interaction-class, and live object-instance handles. Service-group coordinates stay inside the MIM HLAserviceGroup range. The Catch2 case proves equality preservation across joined ambassadors and the current registry keeps a departed federate designator normalizable for the still-joined peer. It does not yet create RTI-originated MOM regions, route MOM reports, prove distributed/external execution semantics, publish package evidence, produce JUnit/protected-review evidence, or claim conformance.
